questions.question: When transliterating into Arabic, how should the personal name “Zakkeer” be rendered?
questions.explanation: The name is transliterated phonetically as زكير. ذاكر is a different Arabic name (from ذكر) and must not be substituted, even though it looks 'more Arabic'. Transliteration preserves the source pronunciation; it does not localise the name.

questions.question: The Indian city “Kozhikode (Calicut)” has a long-established Arabic name. Which spelling reflects it?
questions.explanation: كاليكوت is the historically established Arabic exonym for Calicut (from long-standing trade contact). When a place already has a settled Arabic name, use it rather than an ad-hoc phonetic spelling.

questions.question: A transcript lists the course code “CS-204A”. The draft Arabic reads: «A402-CS». What is the error?
options: The letters should be translated, not kept Latin
The alphanumeric string was reversed; codes must keep their original left-to-right order
questions.answer: The alphanumeric string was reversed; codes must keep their original left-to-right order
questions.explanation: Alphanumeric codes must preserve their original order and direction. In RTL layout the string was mistakenly reversed to A402-CS. The correct form keeps CS-204A intact.

questions.question: In academic transcript translation, a translator renders the grade “B+” as «ب+». Is this advisable?
options: No — grade letters A, B, C are normally kept as Latin characters
Only if the university requests it
questions.answer: No — grade letters A, B, C are normally kept as Latin characters
questions.explanation: Grade letters (A, B, C…) are normally kept as Latin characters in academic translation, because the letter is a fixed scale value. Converting B+ to ب+ changes the graded value and breaks equivalence with the source system.

questions.question: “Power of Attorney” as the name of the legal instrument is best rendered as:
questions.explanation: توكيل رسمي is the established name of the instrument. The alternatives express the general idea of authorising someone but are not the document's name.

questions.question: A contract uses the word “execute” in: “to execute the agreement”. The correct sense here is:
questions.explanation: 'Execute a contract' means to sign/formally conclude it (يُبرم/يوقّع), not to carry out an execution. This is a classic legal false friend.

questions.question: In “the defendant shall be served with the summons”, the verb “served” means:
questions.explanation: 'Served' in procedural law means to be formally notified (يُبلَّغ / يُعلَن), not 'to be served' in the hospitality sense.

questions.question: Which opening is appropriate for the Arabic translation of a formal official letter?
questions.explanation: تحية طيبة وبعد is the standard formal register for official correspondence. The others are colloquial/informal and unsuitable for official documents.

questions.question: An official certificate ends with “Given under my hand this day”. The register-appropriate Arabic is:
questions.explanation: حُرِّر بتاريخه is the fixed formal formula on official documents. The alternatives are colloquial or awkward literal renderings.

questions.question: A birth certificate shows “Date: 09/08/2025 (DD/MM/YYYY)”. A translator writes «2025/08/09» and labels it DD/MM/YYYY. What is wrong?
options: The day/month were silently swapped while keeping the DD/MM/YYYY label, creating a false date
questions.answer: The day/month were silently swapped while keeping the DD/MM/YYYY label, creating a false date
questions.explanation: Reformatting to YYYY/MM/DD while still labelling it DD/MM/YYYY misrepresents the date. Either keep the original order or relabel accurately — never mismatch value and label.

questions.question: An amount reads “AED 10,000”. In the Arabic draft it appears as «10.000 درهم». For a Gulf official document, the risk is:
options: The thousands separator was changed to a decimal point, which can be read as ten (10.000)
درهم is the wrong currency word
Numbers must be written in words only
questions.answer: The thousands separator was changed to a decimal point, which can be read as ten (10.000)
questions.explanation: Swapping the comma thousands-separator for a period can be misread as a decimal (ten). Keep the separator convention unambiguous and consistent with the source's intended value.

questions.question: A source certificate contains a footnote and a disclaimer at the bottom. In the translation these are:
options: Optional — footnotes can be dropped to save space
Omitted because they are not the main text
Fully translated and retained — omissions are a quality defect
Replaced with the translator's own note
questions.answer: Fully translated and retained — omissions are a quality defect
questions.explanation: All footnotes and disclaimer sections must be translated and retained. Omitting them is a flagged quality issue for official documents.

questions.question: Best translation of: «The court sentenced the defendant to two years of imprisonment.»
options: حكمت المحكمة على المدّعى عليه بالسجن سنتين.
المدّعى عليه دخل السجن لمدة عامين.
questions.answer: حكمت المحكمة على المدّعى عليه بالسجن سنتين.
questions.explanation: Option 1 preserves the formal legal register and the correct term المدّعى عليه with accurate structure. The others drop register, misname the party, or paraphrase loosely.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The decision is subject to appeal within fifteen days of issuance.»
options: يمكن الاعتراض على القرار خلال خمسة عشر يوماً.
القرار قابل للاستئناف خلال خمسة عشر يوماً من تاريخ صدوره.
للقرار استئناف بعد خمسة عشر يوم.
questions.answer: القرار قابل للاستئناف خلال خمسة عشر يوماً من تاريخ صدوره.
questions.explanation: Option 2 uses the precise legal collocation قابل للاستئناف and correctly anchors the period to تاريخ صدوره (date of issuance). Others are imprecise or lose the issuance reference.

questions.question: Best translation of: «He filed a complaint against an unknown individual.»
options: عمل بلاغ على حد ما يعرفه.
questions.explanation: قدّم شكوى ضد مجهول is the standard police-report phrasing. مجهول is the fixed term for an unknown perpetrator; the others are colloquial or inaccurate.

questions.question: For a female graduate, the phrase “was admitted to the degree” is drafted as «تم قبوله». The issue is:
options: Gender agreement: it should be تم قبولها for a female
questions.answer: Gender agreement: it should be تم قبولها for a female
questions.explanation: Arabic marks gender. For a female graduate the verb must agree: تم قبولها, not تم قبوله. Gender agreement requires consistent review across a document set.

questions.question: A lab report note “No abnormalities detected” is drafted as «لا شذوذ مكتشف». A cleaner, correct rendering is:
questions.explanation: لم تُكتشف أي شذوذات is the grammatically correct, register-appropriate negation with proper verb agreement, preferred over the awkward «لا شذوذ مكتشف».

questions.question: Best translation of: «The contract shall remain in effect for one year, automatically renewable.»
options: يظل العقد سارياً لمدة سنة قابلة للتجديد تلقائياً.
العقد يستمر عام ثم يتجدد ربما.
questions.answer: يظل العقد سارياً لمدة سنة قابلة للتجديد تلقائياً.
questions.explanation: «يظل ... سارياً» + «قابلة للتجديد تلقائياً» carry the precise legal meaning and register. The others are colloquial or vague.

questions.question: Best rendering of the instruction: «Take the medicine on an empty stomach.»
questions.explanation: «على معدة فارغة» is the standard clinical phrasing. Option 1 states the opposite, and the others are colloquial or inaccurate.

questions.question: Best translation of: «The student is enrolled in the second semester.»
options: الطالب مقيّد في الفصل الدراسي الثاني.
questions.answer: الطالب مقيّد في الفصل الدراسي الثاني.
questions.explanation: «مقيّد في الفصل الدراسي الثاني» is the registrar's phrasing. The others are colloquial or ambiguous.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The applicant appeared in person before the notary.»
options: حضر مقدّم الطلب شخصياً أمام الموثّق.
questions.answer: حضر مقدّم الطلب شخصياً أمام الموثّق.
questions.explanation: «حضر ... شخصياً أمام الموثّق» is the formal notarial wording; «مقدّم الطلب» is the correct term for the applicant.

questions.question: In “each contracting party shall…”, the word “party” is:
questions.explanation: A “party” to a contract is الطرف. الحفلة (a celebration) is the unrelated everyday sense of the same English word.

questions.question: “The patient complained of a cold.” Here “cold” means:
questions.explanation: A “cold” as an illness is نزلة برد. البرودة (coldness/low temperature) is a different sense and wrong in a clinical note.

questions.question: “He missed the class yesterday.” In this context “class” is:
questions.explanation: “Class” as a teaching session is الحصّة/المحاضرة. الطبقة (social class) and الصنف (category) are different senses.

questions.question: “The firm expanded rapidly.” “Firm” here is:
questions.explanation: As a noun, “firm” = الشركة/المنشأة. The adjective senses (صلب/متين/ثابت = firm as in solid) are a false friend here.

questions.question: “The witnesses gave their testimony” is drafted «الشهود أدلى بشهادته». What is wrong?
options: Agreement: a plural subject (الشهود) needs plural agreement — «أدلوا بشهاداتهم»
questions.answer: Agreement: a plural subject (الشهود) needs plural agreement — «أدلوا بشهاداتهم»
questions.explanation: The verb and pronouns must agree with the plural subject: «الشهود أدلوا بشهاداتهم», not the singular «أدلى بشهادته».

questions.question: A cover email says “Please find enclosed our price quotation.” Best Arabic:
questions.explanation: «نرفق لكم طيّه» is the formal enclosure formula. The others are colloquial or abrupt.

questions.question: Best rendering of the label instruction: «Consult your doctor before use.»
questions.explanation: «استشر طبيبك قبل الاستعمال» is the standard, correctly-sequenced label wording. Option 4 reverses the timing (after use).

questions.question: Best translation of: «He passed the examination with distinction.»
questions.explanation: «بتقدير امتياز» is the formal grade band for “with distinction”. The others are colloquial or imprecise about the grade.

questions.question: Best rendering of the contract clause: «This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State.»
options: هذا العقد يتبع الدولة في قوانينها.
تُدار هذه الاتفاقية بحسب دساتير الدولة.
questions.explanation: «يخضع ... لقوانين الدولة» is the standard governing-law collocation. Option 3 is loose, and دساتير (constitutions) is the wrong register for ordinary statute.

questions.question: A draft reads «أُطلق سراح المدّعي بكفالة» for “The defendant was released on bail.” What is the defect?
options: كفالة is the wrong term for bail
المدّعي (plaintiff) was used for “defendant”; it must be المدّعى عليه
questions.answer: المدّعي (plaintiff) was used for “defendant”; it must be المدّعى عليه
questions.explanation: The party was swapped: the defendant is المدّعى عليه, while المدّعي is the plaintiff. Confusing the two reverses who was released — a critical legal error.

questions.question: In “the court handed down a lenient sentence,” the word “sentence” must be translated as:
questions.explanation: “Sentence” here is the punishment (عقوبة/حكم), not a grammatical جملة. A classic false friend that produces nonsense if rendered literally.

questions.question: In a family-law document, “custody of the child” should be:
questions.explanation: Child custody is الحضانة. الحبس الاحتياطي/الاحتجاز are criminal-detention senses of “custody,” and الوصاية is guardianship over property/affairs — related but distinct.

questions.question: For a contract clause “The tenant shall pay the rent monthly,” which rendering mishandles the modal “shall”?
options: على المستأجر أن يدفع الأجرة شهرياً.
questions.explanation: In contracts “shall” expresses obligation, rendered by يلتزم / على المستأجر أن / the jussive-present. «سوف يدفع» turns a binding duty into a mere future prediction.

questions.question: The legalese “hereinafter referred to as the ‘First Party’” is best rendered:
options: المشار إليه فيما بعد بـ«الطرف الأول»
questions.answer: المشار إليه فيما بعد بـ«الطرف الأول»
questions.explanation: «المشار إليه فيما بعد بـ» is the fixed contractual formula. The others are colloquial or loose and break the document's register.

questions.question: Best translation of: «The court dismissed the case for lack of jurisdiction.»
options: ألغت المحكمة القضية لعدم وجود سلطة.
questions.explanation: «ردّ الدعوى لعدم الاختصاص» is the precise procedural collocation. “Dismiss” is not ألغى (annul) or أوقف (suspend), and jurisdiction is الاختصاص, not سلطة/صلاحية.

questions.question: Which is the established rendering of “Power of Attorney” as the name of the instrument (the other three are looser paraphrases)?
questions.explanation: توكيل رسمي is the established name of the instrument. تفويض / إنابة / تخويل convey the general idea of authorising someone but are not the document's name.

questions.question: “The parties reached an amicable settlement.” The word “settlement” here means:
questions.explanation: “Settlement” in dispute resolution is تسوية (ودّية). مستوطنة (a settlement/colony) and توطين are unrelated senses; سداد is repayment.

questions.question: Best rendering of the boilerplate: «This certificate is issued at the request of the applicant without any liability on the issuing authority.»
options: تُصدَر هذه الشهادة بطلب المتقدم وما في مسؤولية على المُصدِر.
تُصدَر هذه الشهادة بناءً على طلب صاحب الشأن دون أدنى مسؤولية على الجهة المُصدِرة.
هذه الوثيقة معطاة للطالب بدون ضمان من الإدارة.
صدرت الشهادة حسب رغبة الشخص دون التزام من المكتب.
questions.answer: تُصدَر هذه الشهادة بناءً على طلب صاحب الشأن دون أدنى مسؤولية على الجهة المُصدِرة.
questions.explanation: Option 2 keeps the formal register and the fixed phrases صاحب الشأن / دون أدنى مسؤولية / الجهة المُصدِرة. The others drop register or use imprecise terms.

questions.question: A certificate shows «1445هـ الموافق 2024م». A draft renders it as «2024هـ الموافق 1445م». The error is:
options: The Hijri and Gregorian years were swapped and mislabelled
questions.answer: The Hijri and Gregorian years were swapped and mislabelled
questions.explanation: The Hijri year (1445هـ) and Gregorian year (2024م) were transposed, attaching the wrong calendar marker to each — a factual date error, not a stylistic one.

questions.question: Under “Marital Status,” the English value “Single” must be rendered as:
questions.explanation: “Single” as a marital status is أعزب (m.) / عزباء (f.). مفرد/فردي (singular/individual) are the grammatical or numeric senses and are wrong on a civil document.

questions.question: “To whom it may concern” at the head of an official letter is fixed as:
questions.explanation: «إلى من يهمه الأمر» is the established formula. The alternatives are understandable but non-standard and would look unprofessional on an official document.

questions.question: “Residence permit” must be distinguished from “visa.” The residence permit is:
questions.explanation: A residence permit is تصريح الإقامة (authorisation to reside). تأشيرة is a visa (entry authorisation) and جواز السفر is a passport — three distinct documents often confused.

questions.question: “The document was attested by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.” “Attested” here is:
questions.explanation: Official “attestation/legalisation” is التصديق: «مصدّق من وزارة الخارجية». شهد (bore witness) and the others do not convey the authentication act.

questions.question: For the name “Zakkeer bin Ahmed,” a draft writes «ذاكر بن أحمد». Why re-open the file?
options: The given name was localised to ذاكر instead of the phonetic زكير
questions.answer: The given name was localised to ذاكر instead of the phonetic زكير
questions.explanation: Transliteration must preserve the source pronunciation: Zakkeer → زكير. Substituting the native-looking ذاكر changes the person's registered name.

questions.question: Best translation of: «Take one tablet twice daily after meals for seven days.»
options: تناول قرصاً واحداً مرة في اليوم قبل الطعام لمدة سبعة أيام.
تناول قرصاً واحداً مرتين يومياً بعد الطعام لمدة سبعة أيام.
خذ حبة كل يوم بعد الأكل لأسبوع.
تناول قرصين يومياً بعد الطعام لمدة سبعة أيام.
questions.answer: تناول قرصاً واحداً مرتين يومياً بعد الطعام لمدة سبعة أيام.
questions.explanation: Only option 2 preserves every clinical value: one tablet, twice daily, after meals, seven days. Option 1 changes frequency and timing; option 4 changes the dose — dangerous mistranslations.

questions.question: In a discharge summary, “Discharge Summary” refers to:
questions.explanation: Hospital “discharge” is الخروج. “Discharge” can also mean a bodily secretion (إفرازات) or electrical/financial senses — but here it is the patient leaving hospital.

questions.question: “The patient is currently on several drugs.” “Drugs” must be rendered:
questions.explanation: In a clinical record “drugs” = أدوية (medications). Rendering it مخدّرات (narcotics) falsely implies substance abuse — a serious meaning shift.

questions.question: A report distinguishes an “acute” from a “chronic” condition. “Chronic” is:
questions.explanation: Chronic = مزمن (long-standing); acute = حاد (sudden/severe onset). Swapping them inverts the clinical picture.

questions.question: A lab remark reads “Results within normal limits.” Best Arabic:
questions.explanation: «ضمن الحدود الطبيعية» is the standard laboratory phrasing. “Good” is vague, “normal limits” ≠ عادية, and option 4 over-asserts beyond the source.

questions.question: “b.i.d.” on a prescription is translated as «مرة واحدة يومياً». The problem:
options: b.i.d. is not a real abbreviation
b.i.d. means twice daily (مرتين يومياً), not once
questions.answer: b.i.d. means twice daily (مرتين يومياً), not once
questions.explanation: b.i.d. (bis in die) = twice daily = مرتين يومياً. Rendering it as once daily halves the prescribed frequency.

questions.question: “The patient was referred to a cardiologist.” “Referred” is best:
questions.explanation: Clinical referral is الإحالة: «أُحيل المريض». نُقل (transferred/moved) is a different act, and حُوّل مالياً is a financial transfer.

questions.question: For a FEMALE graduate, best rendering of “She was admitted to the degree of Bachelor of Science”:
options: تم قبوله في درجة بكالوريوس العلوم.
تم قبولها في درجة بكالوريوس العلوم.
حصلت على البكالوريوس في العلوم فقط.
questions.answer: تم قبولها في درجة بكالوريوس العلوم.
questions.explanation: Gender agreement is obligatory: for a female graduate it is قبولها, not قبوله. Option 1 has the wrong gender; the others drop the formal degree phrasing.

questions.question: “The Faculty of Law” should be translated as:
questions.explanation: “Faculty” here means the college/school = كلية الحقوق. “Faculty” can also mean teaching staff (هيئة التدريس), but that is the wrong sense for a named academic division.

questions.question: A transcript grade “A-” is rendered «أ-» and course code “ENG101” as «101نجليزي». Which statement is correct?
options: Grade letters should stay Latin (A-) and codes must keep original order (ENG101); both were wrongly altered
questions.answer: Grade letters should stay Latin (A-) and codes must keep original order (ENG101); both were wrongly altered
questions.explanation: Two separate rules broke: grade letters A/B/C are normally kept Latin in transcript translation, and alphanumeric course codes keep their original order/direction. Both were corrupted.

questions.question: “Credit hours” on a transcript is:
questions.explanation: Academic “credit hours” = الساعات المعتمدة. «ساعات الائتمان» is a finance calque (credit = ائتمان) and is wrong in an academic context.

questions.question: Best rendering of “He has successfully fulfilled all the requirements for the degree.”
options: نجح في كل شيء للحصول على الشهادة.
استوفى بنجاح جميع متطلبات الحصول على الدرجة.
questions.answer: استوفى بنجاح جميع متطلبات الحصول على الدرجة.
questions.explanation: «استوفى جميع متطلبات الحصول على الدرجة» is the precise, formal degree-conferral wording. The others are loose or (option 4) weaken “all” to “nearly.”

questions.question: The process of having a foreign degree officially recognised as equivalent to a local one is:
questions.explanation: Degree recognition/equivalency is المعادلة. التصديق is attestation of authenticity — a different step — and ترجمة is mere translation.

questions.question: A company file contains both the “Memorandum of Association” and the “Articles of Association.” The Articles of Association are:
questions.explanation: Articles of Association = النظام الأساسي; Memorandum of Association = عقد التأسيس. They are distinct constitutional documents and must not be swapped.

questions.question: “The loan is backed by adequate security.” “Security” here means:
questions.explanation: In finance a loan “security” is a ضمان/رهن (collateral). الأمن (safety) and الأوراق المالية (securities as tradable instruments) are different senses of the same English word.

questions.question: “The account accrues interest at 3% annually.” “Interest” here is:
questions.explanation: Financial “interest” = الفائدة. المصلحة (benefit/interest in a matter) and الاهتمام (curiosity) are unrelated senses that would render the sentence meaningless.

questions.question: The lump-sum entitlement paid to an employee at the end of their employment is:
questions.explanation: «مكافأة نهاية الخدمة» (end-of-service benefit) is the established labour term across Arabic usage. The others name different payments.

questions.question: Best rendering of “This offer shall remain valid for thirty (30) days from the date of issue.”
options: يظل هذا العرض ساري المفعول لمدة ثلاثين (30) يوماً من تاريخ الإصدار.
العرض صالح ثلاثين يوم من يوم كتابته.
questions.answer: يظل هذا العرض ساري المفعول لمدة ثلاثين (30) يوماً من تاريخ الإصدار.
questions.explanation: Option 2 keeps the formal ساري المفعول, the numeral in both words and digits as in the source, and تاريخ الإصدار. The others lose register or precision.

questions.question: A formal business letter closes with “We look forward to your kind cooperation.” Best Arabic:
questions.explanation: «نتطلّع إلى تعاونكم الكريم» matches formal correspondence register. The others are flat, colloquial, or add an unwarranted note of urgency.

questions.question: “Balance Sheet” must be distinguished from “Budget.” The Balance Sheet is:
questions.explanation: Balance Sheet = الميزانية العمومية (financial position at a date); a Budget is الموازنة (a forward plan). They are routinely — and wrongly — conflated.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The witness gave his testimony under oath.»
options: أدلى الشاهد بشهادته بعد أداء اليمين.
حكى الشاهد ما رآه بعد الحلف.
questions.answer: أدلى الشاهد بشهادته بعد أداء اليمين.
questions.explanation: «أدلى بشهادته» and «أداء اليمين» are the fixed legal collocations. The others are loose or colloquial and break the register.

questions.question: “The judge overruled the objection.” “Overruled” must be rendered:
questions.explanation: To “overrule an objection” is to reject it (رفض/ردّ الاعتراض). It is not a literal “ruling over,” and “rule” here is not قاعدة.

questions.question: “The court rescinded the contract.” The precise verb for “rescind” is:
questions.explanation: Rescission of a valid contract is الفسخ. إلغاء (cancellation), إبطال (voiding for invalidity) and تعديل (amendment) are legally distinct acts.

questions.question: “The two parties agreed to the terms” is drafted «اتفق الأطراف على الشروط». The grammatical error is:
options: “Two parties” is a dual and needs الطرفان, not the plural الأطراف
questions.answer: “Two parties” is a dual and needs الطرفان, not the plural الأطراف
questions.explanation: Arabic marks the dual. Exactly two parties = الطرفان (dual): «اتفق الطرفان». الأطراف means three or more.

questions.question: Best rendering of the phrase “the bearer of this document”:
questions.explanation: «حامل هذه الوثيقة» is the fixed term for the bearer. The others are imprecise or literal.

questions.question: “Kindly find the required documents attached.” The register-appropriate Arabic is:
questions.explanation: «تجدون طيّه / مرفقاً» is the formal correspondence formula. The others are colloquial or flat.

questions.question: Which is the grammatically correct MSA form for “three certificates”?
questions.explanation: For numbers 3–10 the number disagrees in gender with the counted noun's singular. شهادة is feminine, so the number drops the tā': «ثلاث شهادات». «ثلاثة شهادات» is the common error.

questions.question: Best translation of: «Discontinue the medication if a rash appears.»
options: أوقف الدواء إذا ظهر طفح جلدي.
questions.answer: أوقف الدواء إذا ظهر طفح جلدي.
questions.explanation: “Discontinue” = أوقف. Option 1 says the opposite (continue) and the others distort the instruction — dangerous in a medical text.

questions.question: In a clinical note, “the patient presented with high fever,” “presented with” means:
options: راجع المريض شاكياً من حمّى عالية
questions.answer: راجع المريض شاكياً من حمّى عالية
questions.explanation: Clinical “presented with” means the patient came in exhibiting the symptom (راجع/حضر وبه). It is not قدّم (to submit/offer).

questions.question: “The patient took an overdose.” “Overdose” is:
questions.explanation: Overdose = جرعة زائدة/مفرطة (excess). جرعة ناقصة is the opposite (a sub-dose).

questions.question: For a FEMALE student, best rendering of “She is expected to graduate next year.”
questions.explanation: Gender agreement: a female subject takes تتخرّج. Option 1 has the wrong gender, and the others drop register or are colloquial.

questions.question: “He sat the exam last week.” The idiom “sat the exam” is best rendered:
questions.explanation: “To sit an exam” means to take it: أدّى/تقدّم للامتحان. The literal جلس على (physically sat on) is a false friend.

questions.question: A certificate opens with “This is to certify that the student…”. The fixed formula is:
questions.explanation: «نشهد بموجب هذا بأنّ» (or يُشهَد بموجبه أنّ) is the standard certification formula. The others are colloquial or non-standard.

questions.question: Best rendering of “The invoice is payable within thirty days of receipt.”
options: تُستحق الفاتورة للدفع خلال ثلاثين يوماً من تاريخ الاستلام.
الفاتورة تُدفع بعد ثلاثين يوماً تقريباً.
questions.answer: تُستحق الفاتورة للدفع خلال ثلاثين يوماً من تاريخ الاستلام.
questions.explanation: «تُستحق للدفع خلال ثلاثين يوماً من تاريخ الاستلام» keeps the precise commercial meaning and register. The others are colloquial or vague («تقريباً» adds imprecision not in the source).

questions.question: “The company's shares rose sharply.” In the stock-market sense, “shares” is:
questions.explanation: Traded stock “shares” = الأسهم. حصص/أنصبة (stakes/portions) and مشاركات (participations) are different senses of “share.”

questions.question: “The company's total revenue increased.” “Revenue” must be distinguished from profit/income; it is:
questions.explanation: Revenue = الإيرادات (total inflow before costs). الأرباح is profit (after costs), الدخل الصافي is net income, رأس المال is capital — all distinct.

questions.question: “The charges against the accused were dropped.” Here “charges” means:
questions.explanation: In a criminal context “charges” are التهم (accusations). الرسوم are fees; the other senses (loads, attacks) are unrelated.

questions.question: “He filed a suit against his employer.” “Suit” here is:
questions.explanation: A legal “suit” is a دعوى (lawsuit). بدلة (a suit of clothes) is the everyday false friend.

questions.question: “Capital punishment was abolished.” “Capital” here means:
questions.explanation: “Capital punishment” = عقوبة الإعدام. العاصمة (capital city) and رأس المال (financial capital) are false friends here.

questions.question: “The parliament passed the bill.” In this context “bill” is:
questions.explanation: A legislative “bill” is مشروع القانون. الفاتورة (invoice) is the commercial false friend.

questions.question: “The defendant will serve a five-year sentence.” “Serve” here means:
questions.explanation: To “serve a sentence” is يقضي العقوبة. يخدم (to serve/work) is the literal false friend.

questions.question: “Defense counsel objected.” “Counsel” here is:
questions.explanation: In court “counsel” means the lawyer(s) — المحامي / هيئة الدفاع — not النصيحة (advice).

questions.question: “The lawyer filed a motion.” “Motion” here is:
questions.explanation: A legal “motion” is a طلب/التماس submitted to the court, not الحركة (physical movement).

questions.question: A court imposed a monetary “fine.” The precise term is:
questions.explanation: A fine is الغرامة. العقوبة is punishment generally, الرسم is a fee, and التعويض is compensation.

questions.question: The head of state issued a “decree.” Best term:
questions.explanation: A decree is المرسوم. اللائحة is a regulation, التعميم a circular, المذكرة a memo.

questions.question: “Armed robbery” is best rendered:
questions.explanation: Armed robbery is السطو المسلح. السرقة is theft generally, الاختلاس embezzlement, النشل pickpocketing.

questions.question: Best translation of: «The accused has the right to remain silent.»
options: حق المتهم أن يكون صامتاً دائماً.
questions.explanation: «للمتهم الحق في التزام الصمت» is the precise legal formulation; the others are colloquial or imprecise.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The contract is null and void.»
questions.explanation: «باطل ولاغٍ» is the fixed legal doublet for “null and void.” The others lose the legal force.

questions.question: “The two witnesses testified” is drafted «شهد الشهود الاثنان». The issue is:
options: For exactly two, the dual شَهِد الشاهدان is required, not the plural الشهود
questions.answer: For exactly two, the dual شَهِد الشاهدان is required, not the plural الشهود
questions.explanation: Two witnesses take the dual: شَهِد الشاهدان. الشهود is a plural (three or more).

questions.question: For a female defendant, “the defendant was acquitted” is drafted «بُرِّئ المدّعى عليه». The defect:
options: Gender: for a female it should be بُرِّئت المدّعى عليها
questions.answer: Gender: for a female it should be بُرِّئت المدّعى عليها
questions.explanation: Gender agreement: a female defendant is المدّعى عليها and the verb becomes بُرِّئت.

questions.question: A judgment closes with “issued and pronounced in open session.” Best Arabic:
questions.explanation: «صدر وتُلي علناً بالجلسة» matches judicial register; the others are colloquial paraphrases.

questions.question: “The court took the matter under advisement.” This means the court:
questions.explanation: “Under advisement” = حجز القضية للمداولة/للحكم (reserved for deliberation), not seeking outside advice.

questions.question: “The appellant” (the one who lodges an appeal) is:
questions.explanation: The appellant is المستأنِف (active). المستأنَف ضده is the appellee (the other side).

questions.question: Best rendering of: «Ignorance of the law is no excuse.»
questions.explanation: «لا يُعذَر أحد بجهله القانون» is the established legal maxim in Arabic.

questions.question: “He was released on his own recognizance.” This means release:
questions.explanation: “On one’s own recognizance” = الإفراج بتعهّد شخصي (a written promise to appear), without posting bail.

questions.question: An official “power of attorney” granting broad authority is a:
questions.explanation: Broad authority = توكيل عام (general POA). توكيل خاص is limited to specified acts.

questions.question: On a form, “Title” before the name (Mr./Dr.) is best rendered:
questions.explanation: A courtesy “title” before a name is اللقب. العنوان (address/heading) and الصك (deed) are false friends.

questions.question: “Present address” on an application means:
questions.explanation: “Present” here is an adjective = current: العنوان الحالي. It is not the verb “to present.”

questions.question: An official “attested/legalised” copy is:
questions.explanation: Attested/legalised = مصدّقة. مترجمة is translated, مطبوعة printed — different attributes.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The applicant hereby declares that the above information is true.»
options: يُقرّ مقدّم الطلب بموجبه بصحة البيانات المذكورة أعلاه.
questions.answer: يُقرّ مقدّم الطلب بموجبه بصحة البيانات المذكورة أعلاه.
questions.explanation: «يُقرّ مقدّم الطلب بموجبه بصحة البيانات المذكورة أعلاه» keeps the declarative register and «بموجبه/أعلاه» formulas.

questions.question: A certificate reads “issued in the city of Cairo”; the draft flips the ID number 100234 to «432001». The error is:
options: A numeric identifier was reversed; identifiers keep their original order
questions.answer: A numeric identifier was reversed; identifiers keep their original order
questions.explanation: Numeric identifiers must retain their original left-to-right order; reversing 100234 to 432001 corrupts the record.

questions.question: Under family details, “issue” in “died without issue” means:
questions.explanation: Legal/civil “issue” means offspring (ذرّية). “Died without issue” = تُوفّي دون عقب/ذرّية.

questions.question: “Certificate of no impediment” (to marriage) is best:
questions.explanation: It certifies there is no legal impediment to marry: شهادة خلو موانع الزواج. The others are unrelated certificates.

questions.question: An official letter opens formally. Choose the correct opening:
questions.explanation: «تحية طيبة وبعد» is the standard official opening; the rest are colloquial.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «This document was translated from the original Arabic.»
options: تُرجمت هذه الوثيقة عن أصلها العربي.
questions.answer: تُرجمت هذه الوثيقة عن أصلها العربي.
questions.explanation: «تُرجمت هذه الوثيقة عن أصلها العربي» is precise and formal, with the correct «عن أصلها».

questions.question: For a female applicant, “the applicant is a resident of Amman” is drafted «مقدّم الطلب مقيم في عمّان» though the applicant is a woman. The issue:
options: Gender: it should be مقدّمة الطلب مقيمة في عمّان
questions.answer: Gender: it should be مقدّمة الطلب مقيمة في عمّان
questions.explanation: Gender agreement across the sentence: مقدّمة الطلب … مقيمة for a female applicant.

questions.question: “The patient is positive for the virus.” “Positive” here means:
questions.explanation: A “positive” test result is نتيجة موجبة — the virus is present. It is not “positive” as in optimistic.

questions.question: “Administer the drug intravenously.” “Administer” here means:
questions.explanation: To “administer a drug” is to give it (يُعطى). It is not the administrative sense of “manage.”

questions.question: “Acute abdominal pain.” “Acute” here means:
questions.explanation: Medical “acute” = حاد (sudden/severe). It is the opposite of مزمن (chronic), not “clever.”

questions.question: A hospital “discharge” of the patient is:
questions.explanation: Here “discharge” is the patient leaving hospital (الخروج), not a bodily secretion (الإفرازات).

questions.question: Best translation of: «Do not exceed the prescribed dose.»
questions.explanation: «لا تتجاوز الجرعة الموصوفة» is precise and correct; the alternatives are colloquial or dangerously loose.

questions.question: “Take three tablets” is drafted «تناول ثلاثة أقراص». The counted noun قرص is masculine. Is the number form correct?
questions.explanation: Number–noun polarity: قرص is masculine, so the number takes the ة form: ثلاثة أقراص. The draft is correct.

questions.question: “The patient complained of a stroke.” “Stroke” here is:
questions.explanation: Medical “stroke” = السكتة الدماغية. The literal “blow/stroke” senses are false friends.

questions.question: A “chronic” illness is:
questions.explanation: Chronic = مزمن (long-standing). حاد is acute, معدٍ contagious, خطير serious — distinct attributes.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The results showed no sign of infection.»
options: لم تُظهر النتائج أي علامة على وجود عدوى.
questions.answer: لم تُظهر النتائج أي علامة على وجود عدوى.
questions.explanation: «لم تُظهر النتائج أي علامة على وجود عدوى» is accurate and formal, with correct negation and agreement.

questions.question: On a prescription, “as needed” is conventionally written:
questions.explanation: «عند الحاجة» is the standard prescription phrasing; the others are colloquial.

questions.question: “Labour” in an obstetric report refers to:
questions.explanation: Obstetric “labour” is المخاض (childbirth process), not “work/labour” in the employment sense.

questions.question: “Referral” of a patient to a specialist is:
questions.explanation: Clinical referral is الإحالة. النقل (transfer) and التحويل المالي (money transfer) are different acts.

questions.question: A report says the female patient «تم إدخاله إلى المستشفى». The defect:
options: Gender: for a female it should be تم إدخالها
questions.answer: Gender: for a female it should be تم إدخالها
questions.explanation: Gender agreement: a female patient — تم إدخالها إلى المستشفى.

questions.question: “He passed the course with distinction.” “Distinction” here is:
questions.explanation: Academic “distinction” = امتياز (top grade). الفرق (difference) and التمييز (discrimination) are false friends.

questions.question: “The subject of the thesis is climate change.” “Subject” here means:
questions.explanation: Here “subject” = الموضوع (topic). المادة (a school subject) is a different sense of the same word.

questions.question: On a transcript, “credit hours” are:
questions.explanation: Academic credit hours = الساعات المعتمدة. «ساعات الائتمان» is a finance calque.

questions.question: “The Faculty of Engineering” — “Faculty” here is:
questions.explanation: As a named division, “Faculty” = الكلية. “Faculty” meaning teaching staff (هيئة التدريس) is the other sense.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The student is required to maintain a minimum GPA of 2.0.»
options: يُشترط على الطالب المحافظة على معدل تراكمي لا يقل عن 2.0.
معدل الطالب ما ينزل عن 2 تقريباً.
questions.answer: يُشترط على الطالب المحافظة على معدل تراكمي لا يقل عن 2.0.
questions.explanation: Option 2 is precise and formal, preserving «لا يقل عن» and the exact figure 2.0.

questions.question: For a female student, “the student was awarded a scholarship” is drafted «مُنِح الطالب منحة». The defect:
options: Gender: for a female it should be مُنِحت الطالبة منحة
questions.answer: Gender: for a female it should be مُنِحت الطالبة منحة
questions.explanation: Gender agreement: مُنِحت الطالبة منحة for a female student.

questions.question: “She sat for the final exam.” “Sat for” means:
questions.explanation: “To sit for an exam” = تقدّم/أدّى الامتحان (to take it), not to physically sit on it.

questions.question: A “transcript” (official record of grades) is:
questions.explanation: An academic transcript is كشف الدرجات. “Transcript” meaning a transcription (تفريغ) is a different sense.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «He successfully defended his doctoral dissertation.»
questions.explanation: «ناقش/دافع عن أطروحته» in the academic sense = مناقشة الأطروحة. Option 2 misreads “defend” as combat.

questions.question: A recommendation letter states formally: “I highly recommend the applicant.” Best Arabic:
questions.explanation: «أوصي بالمتقدّم توصيةً عاليةً» keeps the formal recommendation register.

questions.question: A course marked “core” on a plan is:
questions.explanation: A “core course” is a required course (إجباري/أساسي). The literal “core” senses are false friends.

questions.question: “Withdrawal” from a course on a transcript is:
questions.explanation: Course “withdrawal” = الانسحاب. السحب/الاستقطاع are financial senses of “withdraw.”

questions.question: “The company issued new shares.” “Shares” (in equity) are:
questions.explanation: Tradable equity “shares” = الأسهم. حصص/أنصبة (stakes/portions) are different senses.

questions.question: “The bond matures in ten years.” “Bond” here is:
questions.explanation: A financial “bond” is السند. The emotional/adhesive senses are false friends.

questions.question: “Interest accrues monthly.” “Interest” here is:
questions.explanation: Financial “interest” = الفائدة. الاهتمام/المصلحة are unrelated senses.

questions.question: “The goods are held as security for the loan.” “Security” here is:
questions.explanation: Loan “security” = ضمان/رهن (collateral). الأمن (safety) and الأوراق المالية (securities) are other senses.

questions.question: Distinguish “revenue” from profit: revenue is:
questions.explanation: Revenue = الإيرادات (gross inflow). Profit is الأرباح (after costs).

questions.question: “Articles of Association” of a company are the:
questions.explanation: Articles of Association = النظام الأساسي; Memorandum of Association = عقد التأسيس.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «All prices are subject to change without prior notice.»
options: تخضع جميع الأسعار للتغيير دون إشعار مسبق.
questions.answer: تخضع جميع الأسعار للتغيير دون إشعار مسبق.
questions.explanation: «تخضع … للتغيير دون إشعار مسبق» is the standard commercial disclaimer register.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The invoice must be settled within 30 days.»
options: يجب تسوية الفاتورة خلال ثلاثين يوماً.
questions.answer: يجب تسوية الفاتورة خلال ثلاثين يوماً.
questions.explanation: «يجب تسوية الفاتورة خلال ثلاثين يوماً» is precise; “settle” here = تسوية/سداد.

questions.question: “The firm went into liquidation.” “Liquidation” here is:
questions.explanation: Corporate “liquidation” = التصفية (winding up). The literal “turning to liquid” senses are false friends.

questions.question: “Turnover” meaning total sales is:
questions.explanation: Business “turnover” (sales) = رقم الأعمال. Note “staff turnover” is a different sense (الدوران الوظيفي).

questions.question: “The two companies signed the agreement” is drafted «وقّعت الشركات الاثنتان». The issue:
options: For exactly two, the dual وقّعت الشركتان is required
questions.answer: For exactly two, the dual وقّعت الشركتان is required
questions.explanation: Two companies take the dual: وقّعت الشركتان الاتفاق.

questions.question: A formal business email closes with “We remain at your disposal.” Best Arabic:
questions.explanation: «نبقى رهن إشارتكم» is the formal correspondence equivalent of “at your disposal.”

questions.question: “The board will table the proposal.” In formal usage here “table” means:
questions.explanation: In this register “to table” means to put forward for discussion (يطرح للنقاش). (Note: US usage can mean postpone — context matters.)

questions.question: “Balance sheet” versus “budget”: the balance sheet is:
questions.explanation: Balance sheet = الميزانية العمومية (position at a date). A budget is الموازنة (forward plan).

questions.question: “The principal is bound by the acts of the agent.” “Principal” here is:
questions.explanation: In agency law the “principal” is الموكِّل (who authorises the agent). أصل المبلغ (financial principal) and المدير (school principal) are false friends.

questions.question: “He was found guilty on all counts.” “Counts” here are:
questions.explanation: “Counts” in an indictment are the separate التُّهم (charges), not numbers or accounts.

questions.question: “The legal brief was submitted.” “Brief” here is:
questions.explanation: A legal “brief” is المذكرة القانونية submitted to court, not “brief” as short or underwear.

questions.question: “Legal tender” (money that must be accepted) is:
questions.explanation: “Legal tender” = العملة القانونية. Note “tender” elsewhere means مناقصة (a bid) — a different sense.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The verdict may be appealed within thirty days.»
options: يجوز استئناف الحكم خلال ثلاثين يوماً.
questions.answer: يجوز استئناف الحكم خلال ثلاثين يوماً.
questions.explanation: «يجوز استئناف الحكم خلال ثلاثين يوماً» uses the precise legal collocation and period.

questions.question: A contract states formally: “The parties agree as follows.” Best Arabic:
questions.explanation: «اتفق الطرفان على ما يلي» is correct (dual + formal). Option 1 also mis-inflects الطرفين as subject.

questions.question: “The court will hear the case on Monday.” “Hear” here means:
questions.explanation: For a court, “to hear a case” = ينظر في القضية (adjudicate), not literally to listen.

questions.question: “Bearer” on a certificate (“the bearer is entitled…”) means:
questions.explanation: “Bearer” = حامل الوثيقة (holder). Unrelated to “bear” the animal.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «This is a true and accurate translation of the original.»
questions.explanation: «ترجمة صحيحة ودقيقة للأصل» is the standard translator certification wording.

questions.question: “Sworn translator” (authorised to certify) is:
questions.explanation: A sworn/certified translator is مترجم محلّف. مترجم فوري is a (simultaneous) interpreter — a different role.

questions.question: A date on a form is written «31/13/2024». The translator copies it unchanged. The correct action is:
options: Leave it; not the translator’s concern
Flag the impossible date (month 13) to the client rather than silently altering it
questions.answer: Flag the impossible date (month 13) to the client rather than silently altering it
questions.explanation: Month 13 is impossible; a translator flags evident source errors to the client instead of silently correcting or ignoring them.

questions.question: “Please be informed that…” at the start of an official notice is best:
questions.explanation: «نفيدكم علماً بأنّ» is the formal administrative formula.

questions.question: “The test came back negative.” “Negative” here means:
questions.explanation: A “negative” result is سالبة — no disease detected. Not “negative” as pessimistic.

questions.question: “Blood culture” in a lab request is:
questions.explanation: “Culture” in microbiology = مزرعة (a cultured sample). الثقافة/الحضارة are false friends.

questions.question: “The nurse in charge” — “in charge” means:
questions.explanation: “In charge” = المسؤول(ة). “Charge” as accusation or electrical charge are other senses.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The patient should fast for eight hours before the test.»
options: يجب أن يصوم المريض ثماني ساعات قبل الفحص.
questions.answer: يجب أن يصوم المريض ثماني ساعات قبل الفحص.
questions.explanation: «يصوم … ثماني ساعات قبل الفحص» is precise, including the exact duration.

questions.question: “The patient’s condition is stable.” “Condition” here is:
questions.explanation: Clinical “condition” = الحالة (الصحية). الشرط (a stipulation) is the contractual sense.

questions.question: “Take two spoonfuls” is drafted «تناول ملعقتين اثنتين». What is redundant?
options: The dual ملعقتين already means “two,” so اثنتين is redundant
questions.answer: The dual ملعقتين already means “two,” so اثنتين is redundant
questions.explanation: The dual form ملعقتين inherently means “two spoonfuls”; adding اثنتين is redundant.

questions.question: “Academic term” — “term” here means:
questions.explanation: “Term” as a study period = الفصل الدراسي. المصطلح (a term/word) and الشرط (condition) are other senses.

questions.question: “First class honours” — “class” here means:
questions.explanation: “Class” in “first class” = the grade/rank (المرتبة). الفصل/الحصة (classroom/lesson) are other senses.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «Attendance is compulsory for all lectures.»
questions.explanation: «الحضور إلزامي لجميع المحاضرات» is the formal, precise rendering.

questions.question: “The dean of the college” — “dean” is:
questions.explanation: A college “dean” is العميد. المدير/الرئيس are general and would not name the office correctly.

questions.question: “The outstanding balance is due.” “Outstanding” here means:
questions.explanation: “Outstanding balance” = الرصيد المستحق (unpaid). “Outstanding” as excellent (متميّز) is the false friend.

questions.question: “Please honour the enclosed cheque.” “Honour” here means:
questions.explanation: To “honour a cheque” = صرفه/الوفاء بقيمته. The “respect/honour” senses are false friends.

questions.question: “Goods in stock.” “Stock” here means:
questions.explanation: “In stock” = المخزون (inventory). “Stock” as shares (الأسهم) is a different business sense.

questions.question: “The principal amount of the loan” — “principal” here is:
questions.explanation: Financial “principal” = أصل المبلغ (the sum before interest). The agency and school senses are false friends.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «This offer is non-negotiable.»
questions.explanation: «غير قابل للتفاوض» is the precise, formal equivalent of “non-negotiable.”

questions.question: “We regret to inform you that your application was unsuccessful.” Best Arabic:
questions.explanation: «يؤسفنا إبلاغكم بعدم قبول طلبكم» carries the formal, courteous register expected in such letters.

questions.question: “The concern was declared bankrupt.” “Concern” here means:
questions.explanation: A “going concern/business concern” = المنشأة/الشركة. القلق/الاهتمام are the emotional false friends.

questions.question: “Tax return” filed annually is:
questions.explanation: A “tax return” (the filed declaration) = الإقرار الضريبي. A refund would be إرجاع/استرداد — a different thing.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The plaintiff seeks damages for breach of contract.»
options: يطالب المدّعي بالتعويض عن الإخلال بالعقد.
المدعي يبي يعوّض عن مشكلة العقد.
طلب المدعي تعويض لأن العقد خرب.
questions.answer: يطالب المدّعي بالتعويض عن الإخلال بالعقد.
questions.explanation: «يطالب المدّعي بالتعويض عن الإخلال بالعقد» is precise and formal, with the correct terms المطالبة/التعويض/الإخلال.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «This agreement remains in force until terminated by either party.»
options: الاتفاق شغّال لحد ما حدا يوقفه.
يظل هذا الاتفاق سارياً حتى يُنهيه أحد الطرفين.
questions.answer: يظل هذا الاتفاق سارياً حتى يُنهيه أحد الطرفين.
questions.explanation: «يظل … سارياً حتى يُنهيه أحد الطرفين» keeps «ساري المفعول» and correct agency of termination.

questions.question: A contract ends with “In witness whereof, the parties have signed below.” Best Arabic:
options: وإثباتاً لما تقدّم، وقّع الطرفان أدناه.
questions.answer: وإثباتاً لما تقدّم، وقّع الطرفان أدناه.
questions.explanation: «وإثباتاً لما تقدّم … أدناه» is the fixed attestation clause register.

questions.question: “The award of damages” — “damages” here is:
questions.explanation: Legal “damages” (the sum awarded) = التعويضات. الأضرار are the harms themselves; الغرامات are fines.

questions.question: A draft renders “the plaintiff sued the defendant” as «رفع المدّعى عليه دعوى على المدّعي». The error:
options: The roles are reversed — the plaintiff (المدّعي) sues the defendant (المدّعى عليه)
questions.answer: The roles are reversed — the plaintiff (المدّعي) sues the defendant (المدّعى عليه)
questions.explanation: The parties were swapped: it is the المدّعي who sues the المدّعى عليه, not the reverse.

questions.question: “Guardianship over a minor’s property” is:
questions.explanation: Guardianship over property/affairs = الوصاية. الحضانة is physical custody of the child — a distinct concept.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The undersigned certifies the accuracy of the foregoing.»
options: اللي وقّع بيأكد إن الكلام صح.
يشهد الموقّع أدناه بصحة ما تقدّم.
questions.answer: يشهد الموقّع أدناه بصحة ما تقدّم.
questions.explanation: «يشهد الموقّع أدناه بصحة ما تقدّم» is the correct formal certification wording.

questions.question: Having a document “notarized” refers to:
questions.explanation: Notarization = التوثيق (before a notary). Consular legalization (التصديق) is a separate later step.

questions.question: An official memo states: “Kindly note that the deadline has been extended.” Best Arabic:
options: يُرجى العلم بأنّه قد جرى تمديد الموعد النهائي.
questions.answer: يُرجى العلم بأنّه قد جرى تمديد الموعد النهائي.
questions.explanation: «يُرجى العلم بأنّه قد جرى تمديد …» matches formal administrative register.

questions.question: For a female bearer, “the bearer is hereby authorized” is drafted «يُصرّح لحاملها بموجبه» while referring to a named woman as حامل. The best fix:
options: Use حاملتها and keep agreement feminine throughout
questions.answer: Use حاملتها and keep agreement feminine throughout
questions.explanation: If the bearer is a specific woman, agreement should be feminine (حاملتها …) consistently.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «Issued without alteration or erasure.»
options: صدر خالياً من أي كشط أو تعديل.
questions.answer: صدر خالياً من أي كشط أو تعديل.
questions.explanation: «خالياً من أي كشط أو تعديل» is the fixed formula on official documents.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «Apply the ointment to the affected area twice daily.»
options: يُدهن المرهم على المنطقة المصابة مرتين يومياً.
questions.answer: يُدهن المرهم على المنطقة المصابة مرتين يومياً.
questions.explanation: «يُدهن … على المنطقة المصابة مرتين يومياً» preserves every instruction precisely.

questions.question: “Once daily” is drafted «مرتين يومياً». The problem:
options: Frequency doubled: “once daily” is مرة واحدة يومياً, not مرتين
questions.answer: Frequency doubled: “once daily” is مرة واحدة يومياً, not مرتين
questions.explanation: “Once daily” = مرة واحدة يومياً. Rendering it مرتين doubles the prescribed frequency — a dosing error.

questions.question: On a chart, a “sign” (objective finding) versus a “symptom” — a “symptom” is:
questions.explanation: A symptom (patient-reported) = العَرَض; a sign (observed) = العلامة. They are technically distinct.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The patient has no known drug allergies.»
options: لا توجد لدى المريض حساسية معروفة تجاه الأدوية.
ما في حساسية عند المريض للأدوية غالباً.
questions.answer: لا توجد لدى المريض حساسية معروفة تجاه الأدوية.
questions.explanation: Option 2 is complete and precise («معروفة تجاه الأدوية»); the others drop “known/drug” or add hedging.

questions.question: On a prescription, “to be taken as directed” is best written:
questions.explanation: «يُؤخذ حسب إرشادات الطبيب» is the conventional prescription phrasing.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The university hereby confers the degree of Master of Arts.»
options: تمنح الجامعة بموجبه درجة الماجستير في الآداب.
questions.answer: تمنح الجامعة بموجبه درجة الماجستير في الآداب.
questions.explanation: «تمنح الجامعة بموجبه درجة الماجستير في الآداب» matches the formal conferral wording.

questions.question: For a female graduate, “he ranked first in his cohort” is drafted «حصل على المركز الأول على دفعته». The defect:
options: Gender: it should be حصلت … دفعتها for a female
questions.answer: Gender: it should be حصلت … دفعتها for a female
questions.explanation: Gender agreement across the sentence: حصلت … على دفعتها for a female graduate.

questions.question: Who keeps the official student records — the “registrar” is:
questions.explanation: The registrar (records office) = المسجّل. العميد is the dean — a different office.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «She fulfilled all graduation requirements.»
questions.explanation: «استوفت جميع متطلبات التخرج» is precise, formal, and correctly feminine; option 4 weakens “all.”

questions.question: Best rendering of: «Delivery is subject to availability of stock.»
questions.explanation: «يخضع التسليم لتوفّر المخزون» is the precise commercial phrasing.

questions.question: On a balance sheet, “liabilities” are:
questions.explanation: Liabilities = الخصوم/الالتزامات (what is owed). الأصول are assets — the opposite side.

questions.question: An amount “1,250.00” is rendered «1.250,00» and labelled the same currency. For a reader expecting the source convention, the risk is:
options: The separators were swapped (period/comma), which can change the read value
questions.answer: The separators were swapped (period/comma), which can change the read value
questions.explanation: Swapping thousands/decimal separators can alter the perceived value; keep the source convention consistent and unambiguous.

questions.question: A business letter asks the client to reply “at your earliest convenience.” Best Arabic:
options: نرجو الردّ في أقرب وقت ممكن.
questions.answer: نرجو الردّ في أقرب وقت ممكن.
questions.explanation: «نرجو الردّ في أقرب وقت ممكن» is the courteous formal equivalent.

questions.question: “Net profit” versus “gross profit”: the “net” profit is:
questions.explanation: Net profit = after deducting all costs; gross profit = before deducting operating costs and taxes.

questions.question: Best rendering of: «The seller shall bear all shipping costs.»
questions.explanation: «يتحمّل البائع كافة تكاليف الشحن» is precise and formal, with «يتحمّل/كافة».
